title: NanoVI pipeline parameters
description: Taxonomic classification of full-length 16S rRNA Nanopore reads using variational inference

input.description: Samplesheet CSV (columns sample, fastq) or a directory of FASTQ files

db.description: Reference database directory containing species_taxid.fasta (and taxonomy.tsv unless --taxonomy_tsv is given)

db_index.description: Prebuilt minimap2 index (.mmi) of the database's species_taxid.fasta. It is used as given, without INDEX_DB, so build it with the same minimap2 version, -x <type> and -k <kmer_size> as the run (for example from the index cache of an earlier run)

index_cache_dir.description: Directory where INDEX_DB keeps the minimap2 indexes it builds, one per database checksum, --type, --kmer_size and minimap2 version; a later run with the same settings reuses the index. Default: <output_dir>/index_cache

taxonomy_tsv.description: Path to taxonomy TSV file matching the reference database

kmer_size.description: K-mer size for minimap2 alignment indexing and mapping

N.description: Maximum number of secondary alignments reported by minimap2 per read

K.description: Minibatch size for minimap2 mapping (minimap2 -K: bases loaded per batch; a number, optionally with K, M or G)

split_prefix.description: Prefix for minimap2 temporary split index files

min_length.description: Minimum read length kept by fastplong (bp)

max_length.description: Maximum read length kept by fastplong (bp)

min_quality.description: Minimum mean read quality (Phred) for fastplong's quality filter. Off by default (length filter only)

keep_counts.description: Include estimated read counts column in output abundance tables

keep_files.description: Retain intermediate files (SAM alignments, filtered FASTQs) in output directory

estimator.description: Estimator: 'vb' (Bayesian variational inference, default) or 'em' (Emu-style expectation-maximization)

min_abundance.description: Lowest abundance reported. VB prunes species below max(1/R, min_abundance), or max(10/R, min_abundance) above 1,000 reads with an alignment (R)

vi_tolerance.description: VB only: CAVI stops when no posterior mean abundance changes by more than this between iterations

vi_max_iterations.description: VB only: most CAVI iterations per pruning round

alpha_prior.description: VB only: total concentration of the symmetric Dirichlet prior (each species gets alpha_prior / S)

vi_elbo_threshold.description: EM only: the EM loop stops when the log-likelihood rises by less than this

credible_intervals.description: Experimental, VB only: add ci_lower, ci_upper (95% mean-field interval) and shared_read_fraction columns. The intervals are too narrow for species that share reads

db_name.description: Name for the custom database to build

sequences.description: Path to input FASTA file with reference sequences

seq2tax.description: Path to sequence-to-taxonomy mapping TSV file

ncbi_taxonomy.description: Path to NCBI taxonomy dump directory (containing names.dmp and nodes.dmp). build-database needs exactly one of ncbi_taxonomy or taxonomy_list

taxonomy_list.description: Path to taxonomy terms list TSV file. build-database needs exactly one of taxonomy_list or ncbi_taxonomy

input_tsv.description: Path to abundance table TSV for taxonomy collapse

input_dir.description: Path to directory containing per-sample abundance tables for combining

rank.description: Taxonomic rank for collapse or combine operations

resource_options.title: Resource limits
resource_options.description: Caps on what any task asks for, on every retry (process.resourceLimits)

max_cpus.description: Most CPUs a task may ask for

max_memory.description: Most memory a task may ask for, e.g. 64.GB. main.nf reads it as a memory unit, which nf-schema checks as a number of bytes

max_time.description: Most time a task may ask for, e.g. 24.h. main.nf reads it as a duration, which nf-schema checks as milliseconds
